desc: Implement full solution: parse rows into W-bit integer masks and build frequency array f of size 2^W.
Precompute g[x] = min(popcount(x), W - popcount(x)) for all x in [0, 2^W).
Implement iterative in-place Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform for XOR convolution; apply to f and g, multiply pointwise, inverse transform (divide by 2^W), yielding h = f (*) g.
Output min(h[mask]) over all 2^W column masks.
Verify edge cases (W=1, H=1, all rows identical, max H=2e5) and confirm sample outputs 2, 0, 13.
Confirm FWHT-based XOR convolution is the intended efficient approach (O(W·2^W)).
All 3 public samples passed; solution accepted.
